title: The Eiffel Tower Grows Taller in Summer
description: The iron tower in Paris expands in the heat and can stand about fifteen centimeters taller on hot days.

scenes.text: The Eiffel Tower gets taller every summer.
scenes.subject: eiffel
scenes.say: [excited] The Eiffel Tower gets TALLER every summer.

scenes.text: It is built from iron, and metal expands when it heats up.
scenes.subject: eiffel
scenes.say: It is built from iron, and metal expands when it heats up.

scenes.text: On hot days, the tower can grow by up to about fifteen centimeters. That is about six inches.
scenes.subject: eiffel
scenes.say: On hot days, the tower can grow by up to about fifteen centimeters. [gasps] That is about six inches.

scenes.text: And because the Sun heats one side more than the other, the top can lean slightly away from the Sun during the day.
scenes.subject: eiffel
scenes.say: And because the Sun heats one side more than the other, the top can lean slightly away from the Sun during the day.

scenes.text: In winter, it shrinks back down again. Follow for more weird facts.
scenes.subject: eiffel
scenes.say: [sighs] In winter, it shrinks back down again. [chuckles] Follow for more weird facts.
